mission: SNKRDUNK requeue after the class-name parser fix (owner decision 2026-10-27, perfectionist: canary then the rest). From 2026-10-26 ~08:29Z until #223's fix reached every collector (#224, 2026-10-27 07:04Z), every SNKRDUNK refresh was refused main_image_not_found and identity_refusal blocked its work: 284 items, all with that reason; blocked work is never retried, so SNKRDUNK had nothing to refresh. New owner-gated ops-write snkr-parser-requeue: app.services.snkr_parser_requeue.preview (read-only) plans either one canary (count 1) or, once a refused item has captured a price on the new code and nothing was refused again on it, every remaining refused item; apply re-runs the plan under row locks and only reopens the approved work (pending, due now, original reason kept behind a requeue marker). Only work refused for exactly that reason between 2026-10-26 08:00Z and 2026-10-27 07:04Z is eligible; older quarantine is never touched. No source request, no collector code change.

impacts.reason: Plan and apply for reopening the parser-bug refusals (state blocked -> pending on at most 284 SNKRDUNK refresh rows, only through the owner-approved runbook). Not imported by any collector path.
ops-write snkr-parser-requeue: dry run shows the plan and its SHA; apply writes exactly that plan after the staging fingerprint check.
Runbook choice and input descriptions. No secret, gate, permission or timeout change.

Canary reopens one item only; a second canary waits; the rest needs a proven capture and stops on a refusal on the new code; window and reason filter; ineligible mappings reported; apply writes only the approved plan; read-only preview; runbook mode, SHA and apply gate.

resources: SNKRDUNK freshness_work rows refused by the parser bug (at most 284)
routes: The scheduled SNKRDUNK collector refreshes the reopened work; no new route
dependencies: staging after #225 (collectors on the fixed parser)
impact.deployment_impact: No collector rollout. Behaviour changes only after an owner-approved apply: the reopened items are refreshed by the next SNKRDUNK turns.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file; reopened rows that refuse again block themselves (identity_refusal), so no manual row repair is needed.
recovery.trigger: The canary or reopened items refused again on the new code, or prices mis-parsed.

verification.observation_window: Canary dry run and apply, the next SNKRDUNK turn (db-diagnostic snkrdunk-quarantine, staging-state), then the rest.
